title: Hill-based reformulation of the Hodgkin-Huxley model for mapping gating changes to neuronal excitability

comments: The framework trades quantitative accuracy for reproducibility and tractability when kinetic data are sparse, but full prediction requires additional cellular constraints often unavailable in mutation reports.

Classical Hodgkin-Huxley model

title: BALANCE-ST: distilling deep reinforcement learning policies into PLC logic for multi-VFD load balancing

model_io.model: DQN teacher → decision-tree distillation + deterministic guard (IEC 61131-3 Structured Text)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gravity and drive torque induce vertical-rotational coupling that shifts natural frequencies and intensifies modal interaction

model_io.model: Micro-Raman spectroscopy of powdered fuel debris
